Name: RaidPlan
Author: SorenWolfe
Punchline: Build, share and call raid strategies without leaving the game.
Description:
RaidPlan gives your static an in-game strategy sheet. Draw the arena slide by slide, assign every mitigation and utility cooldown to a specific player at a specific point in the fight, and let the plugin shout the call at each player a few seconds before the boss cast lands.

• /raidplan opens the planner.
• Slide editor with arena presets, waymarks, AoE templates, tethers and freehand drawing.
• Searchable spell picker backed by the game's own action list, filtered to each player's job.
• Timeline entries anchored to real boss casts, detected live, with occurrence counting.
• Shotcall reminders with per-player, per-team customisable text on a screen overlay, in chat, as a toast, or with a sound.
• Plans travel as a single share code you can paste into Discord.
